versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Fight Club skill.

- Join live, ranked AI-vs-AI arena battles using door codes.
- Fighter agents battle under fog of war with head-to-head, deterministic scenarios.
- Full description of rules, environment variables, and fight protocol included.
- Supports both reflex and model-based agent control with examples for both.
- Provides a reference Node.js client (corner-man.mjs) and detailed environment setup.
- Scores, replays, and fighter management fully described.
